title: Why Your Controller Moves By Itself: The Real Reason for Stick Drift #shorts

cast.nia: a ten-year-old girl with curly dark brown hair in two round puffs, a bright yellow hoodie, blue jeans and purple sneakers
cast.bro: a skinny teenage boy with messy red hair, freckles and a plain green t-shirt

lines.text: What kept walking Nia's player off cliffs the night before her big gaming final?
lines.label: THE HOOK
lines.headline: PLAYER WALKS BY ITSELF
lines.image: {nia} sitting on the floor of her cozy bedroom at night, holding a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos) with both thumbs lifted off the sticks, gasping in shock at a glowing TV where a small cartoon game hero walks off a cliff edge by itself, dramatic, she is the only person in the picture

lines.text: Nia had practiced every night for weeks, and the school final was tomorrow morning.
lines.label: THE SETUP
lines.headline: WEEKS OF PRACTICE
lines.image: {nia} sitting cross-legged on her bedroom floor late at night, playing a video game on a glowing TV with a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos) in her hands, focused and determined, a small empty gold trophy shelf on the wall behind her, moonlight in the window, she is the only person in the picture

lines.text: But tonight, her character kept sliding left, even with both thumbs off the stick.
lines.label: THE PROBLEM
lines.headline: IT MOVES ON ITS OWN
lines.image: close-up of {nia} holding a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos) out in front of her with both thumbs raised high off the sticks, her eyes wide and confused, the glowing TV behind her shows a tiny game hero sliding to the left, bedroom at night, she is the only person in the picture

lines.text: Her brother blamed dust, so she scrubbed around the stick with a cotton swab.
lines.label: FIX ONE
lines.headline: MAYBE IT'S DUST
lines.image: {nia} sitting at her desk under a lamp, carefully scrubbing around a thumbstick of a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos) with a white cotton swab, while {bro} leans in the bedroom doorway behind her pointing at the controller with a know-it-all smile, exactly two people in the picture

lines.text: It still drifted, and she slid off the same ledge three times in a row.
lines.label: STILL BROKEN
lines.headline: THREE FALLS IN A ROW
lines.image: {nia} slumped on her bedroom floor with a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos) in her lap, groaning with her head tilted back in frustration, the glowing TV in front of her shows a tiny game hero falling off a stone ledge, bedroom at night, she is the only person in the picture

lines.text: A new controller cost sixty dollars, and every store in town was already closed.
lines.label: NO WAY OUT
lines.headline: STORES ARE CLOSED
lines.image: {nia} standing at her dark bedroom window at night, holding a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos) and an empty piggy bank, looking out sadly at a quiet small-town street where every shop is dark and closed, worried mood, she is the only person in the picture

lines.text: Nia looked up the real reason a controller starts moving on its own.
lines.label: THE SEARCH
lines.headline: THE REAL REASON
lines.image: {nia} sitting on her bed at night, reading a glowing tablet with a curious, determined face, a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos) lying beside her on the blanket, soft blue screen light on her face, she is the only person in the picture

lines.text: Inside each stick, a tiny metal arm rubs back and forth on a carbon strip.
lines.label: INSIDE THE STICK
lines.headline: A METAL ARM ON CARBON
lines.image: {nia} holding a big magnifying glass up to a giant floating cartoon cutaway of a thumbstick from a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos), showing inside it a tiny shiny metal arm sliding over a curved black carbon strip, amazed face, bedroom at night, she is the only person in the picture

lines.text: Each push scrapes off carbon, until the worn strip senses pushes that aren't there.
lines.label: WEAR AND TEAR
lines.headline: THE STRIP WEARS THIN
lines.image: giant cartoon close-up cutaway inside a thumbstick of a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos): a tiny shiny metal arm scraping along a curved black carbon strip that is worn thin and patchy in the middle, little black carbon flakes floating away, {nia} small in the corner watching with her mouth open, she is the only person in the picture

lines.text: Dust was never the problem: her own weeks of practice had worn the strip out.
lines.label: THE TWIST
lines.headline: HER PRACTICE DID IT
lines.image: close-up of {nia} staring down at a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos) in her hands with a stunned face and her mouth open in realization, the controller's thumbsticks worn shiny from use, bedroom at night, dramatic light, she is the only person in the picture

lines.text: So she raised the dead zone setting, which tells the game to ignore tiny pushes.
lines.label: THE HERO MOVE
lines.headline: RAISE THE DEAD ZONE
lines.image: {nia} sitting on her bedroom floor, grinning and pressing a button on a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos), the glowing TV in front of her shows a simple settings screen with one long slider bar moving to the right, no words, clever triumphant mood, she is the only person in the picture

lines.text: Her player stood perfectly still, and the next morning, Nia won the whole final.
lines.label: THE WIN
lines.headline: SHE WINS THE FINAL
lines.image: {nia} on a small stage in a bright school gym, holding a plain light-gray game controller (an inanimate object with two black thumbsticks and four round colored buttons, no face, no arms, no feet, no logos) in one hand and lifting a shiny gold trophy high with the other, cheering kids blurred in the background, colorful confetti in the air, joyful and triumphant
